lines.text: Entry price unchanged since addition. That's either patience or the market confirming the thesis.
The confidence score reflects scout assessment at time of addition, not a prediction.
PnL tracks from scout entry, not your entry. Adjust expectations accordingly.
The reward mechanic is the reason it's here. Price movement is secondary.
Scout added this one four months ago. The reward clarity came later.
Strategy stack is MSTR and preferreds. The tokenized forms track within basis points.
Solana-native means on-chain settlement. That's the entire infrastructure advantage.
Hold-to-earn isn't staking. The yield accrues from protocol mechanics, not validator rewards.
Market cap estimates vary by source. We show what DexScreener reports at fetch time.
This is a position tracker, not a recommendation engine. Do your own research.
Prices refresh hourly via GitHub Action. Intraday moves won't show until next commit.
Curator adds tokens with explicit reward mechanics. Memes without yield don't make the cut.
DexScreener links go to the exact pair tracked. Different pairs may show different prices.
Preferred shares show fixed or variable dividend rates. Check the description for terms.
1:1 redeemable means Backpack will convert to real shares. Synthetic trackers settle in cash.
Most scout picks sit at 75 confidence. Below 50 means experimental or unconfirmed mechanics.
Zero PnL means entry equals current. Boring, but less volatile than the alternative.
Added dates track when scout included the token. First seen may predate that by weeks.
